fixed_question: Intentional subject/Motion-class change (e.g. emissive flicker) vs unintended recolour?
observed_feature: Wholesale per-frame recolour of same airborne subject (hat/body hues swap while pose/silhouette hold)
rationale: Candidate and proposed_hard_fail_reference share raw_sha256 and sit at metric=hard_fail_boundary 0.2793 (above budget 0.2423). Across f0–f3 the same pickaxe-bearing figure keeps pose/silhouette while hat and clothing hues jump (blue/green → yellow/red → white/purple → black/orange). The quantized_palette_histogram panels show correspondingly distinct dominant bins each frame, unlike the budget_binding_good moth strip whose palette stays stable. That pattern is unintended recolour, not intentional subject or motion-class change such as localized emissive flicker. Valid hard-fail reference for palette_drift.
